title: Automatic Construction of a Korean Toxic Instruction Dataset for Ethical Tuning of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with automatically generated instructions containing politician names and political party affiliations, and conducting human evaluation of the model responses to classify them as neutral/ethical, risky/unethical, or irrelevant/incorrect.
Evaluating LLM responses to instructions containing gender-based derogatory terms and slurs (e.g., targeting feminists, specific genders), followed by human evaluation of response safety.
Testing LLMs using template-generated instructions containing racial or nationality-based hate speech (e.g., targeting East Asians, Westerners), and scoring the responses via human annotation.
Assessing model safety by prompting them with derogatory instructions targeting religious groups (e.g., Christians, Unification Church) and evaluating the outputs for ethical refusal.
Prompting models with instructions containing homophobic slurs and hate speech targeting sexual minorities, evaluated via human annotation.
Including age-related derogatory terms (e.g., 'old fogey') in the dataset's 'Hate' category and evaluating model responses to these toxic queries.
Categorizing disability as a target group within the 'Hate' instruction dataset to evaluate whether models ethically reject or safely handle associated toxic queries.
